info.name: ALZAMO PST v5 - REQ-CART-001 - Multi-step SIT reference
info.description: External execution proof of concept for ALZAMO SIT-008. Execute collection IN ORDER using Postman Collection Runner. Source: https://api.practicesoftwaretesting.com/docs?api-docs.json . This collection sends POST requests to the publicly hosted PST v5 demo, creating a cart and adding a product. Use only this training environment. There is deliberately no DELETE/cleanup call. The published CartResponse documents only id, so AC-04 must remain INCONCLUSIVE unless product and quantity are independently observable at runtime. The selected product comes from GET /products data[] (if available) and the cart ID from POST /carts id. This demonstrates a multi-operation API workflow, not proven integration of independently deployed systems. No ALZAMO webhooks or AI requests are sent.

request.description: REQ-CART-001 AC-01. Reads a current productId from response.data[]. No fixed product identifiers; if none is observed, stop without mutations.

exec: // Reset any evidence from prior runs so stale IDs cannot create a false pass.
// FRS AC-01. OpenAPI: GET /products -> 200 PaginatedProductResponse.data[] -> ProductResponse.id.
try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { /* reported by tests */ }
const products = body && Array.isArray(body.data) ? body.data : null;
const chosen = products && products.find(p => p && typeof p.id === 'string' && p.id.trim().length > 0 && p.in_stock !== false);
pm.test('AC-01: a selectable product ID is observed in response.data[]',function(){
pm.expect(products,'The documented pagination data array must be observable at runtime').to.be.an('array');
pm.expect(chosen,'Select an existing product; do not assume a fixed ID or fixture').to.be.an('object');
console.log('AC-01 product selected from observed API response:',chosen.id);
pm.collectionVariables.set('sitEvidenceGap','No suitable existing product ID was observed from GET /products.');
pm.execution.setNextRequest(null); // Stops an ordered Collection Runner run.

item.name: 02 - POST carts: create and capture cartId

request.description: REQ-CART-001 AC-02. Only run after 01. Creates one demo cart; extracts /id from documented HTTP 201 JSON response.

exec: // Never create a cart when product selection failed, even if this request is sent alone.
pm.collectionVariables.set('sitEvidenceGap','Select a product through request 01 before creating a cart.');
// FRS AC-02. OpenAPI: POST /carts -> HTTP 201 JSON {id:string}.
const id=body && typeof body.id==='string' && body.id.trim() ? body.id : null;
pm.test('AC-02: newly created cart ID is an observed nonempty string',function(){pm.expect(id).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty;});
console.log('AC-02 cart ID created and captured:',id);
